biotools.summary: Desktop viewer for microscopy and whole slide pathology images on Windows and macOS. Opens whole slide scanner formats (Aperio SVS, Hamamatsu NDPI, MIRAX MRXS, Leica SCN, Ventana BIF) alongside acquisition formats (Zeiss CZI, Nikon ND2, DICOM, TIFF/OME-TIFF) in a single application, providing pyramid navigation of gigapixel images, metadata inspection, calibrated measurements, annotations, and on-device segmentation and object counting.
